blocks.text: Aaj hum 2 crore (20 million) se zyada aise compounds jante hain jin mein carbon hota hai. In mein se zyada tar organic chemistry mein parhe jate hain. IUPAC organic chemistry ki definition (taareef) yun karta hai: “un compounds ki study (mutala) jin mein carbon ho, aur carbon khud apne aap se, hydrogen se ya doosre elements se jura ho, siwaye kuch inorganic compounds ke.”

Kuch compounds mein carbon hone ke bawajood unhein purane waqt se inorganic mana jata hai aur organic chemistry se bahar rakha jata hai: carbonates, cyanides (maslan KCN), CO₂, CO waghera. Organic compounds ko inorganic compounds se un ki khaas properties (khoobiyon) se aasani se pehchana ja sakta hai: kam melting point aur boiling point, kam density aur paani mein kam solubility (ghulne ki salahiyat).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab cyanide ki misal “KCl” deti hai. KCl potassium chloride hai, cyanide nahi. Sahi misal KCN (potassium cyanide) hai.

blocks.title: Catenation
blocks.text: Aik hi element ke atoms ka aapas mein jur jana (self-linkage) catenation kehlata hai. Yeh lafz Latin ke “catena” se hai, jis ka matlab hai zanjeer (chain).
Carbon mazboot (stable) C – C covalent bonds ke zariye lambi chains (zanjeerein) aur rings (halqe) banata hai. Carbon atoms ka khud se jurna organic chemistry mein bohat ahem hai.

Carbon tetravalent hai, yani chaar bonds banata hai. Is liye carbon atoms bohat se alag alag tareeqon se jur kar tarah tarah ke compounds bana sakte hain. Maslan sirf chaar carbon atoms bhi chaar alag arrangements (tarteebon) mein jur sakte hain.

blocks.alt: Chaar carbon atoms ke chaar arrangements, har C seedhi lakeeron se jura: seedhi chain C-C-C-C; teen C ki chain jis ke beech wale C ke neeche chautha C; square ke chaar konon par chaar C; aur teen C ka triangle jis ke oopar wale C par chautha C.
blocks.caption: Chaar carbon atoms ke chaar alag arrangements (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Chaaron shakalon mein sirf carbon ka skeleton (dhaancha) dikhaya gaya hai; har C ke baqi bond H atoms se poore hote hain. Pehli seedhi chain (straight chain) hai: butane. Doosri branched chain (shaakh wali chain) hai: 2-methylpropane. Teesri chaar carbon ka ring hai: cyclobutane. Chauthi teen carbon ka ring aur us par aik branch hai: methylcyclopropane. Yahi catenation hai: carbon khud se jur kar chains aur rings banata hai.
Catenation hi batata hai ke organic compounds itne complex (pecheeda) kyun hain, un ke structures itne bare kyun hain aur un ki itni zyada types kyun hain.

blocks.prompt: a) Paanch carbon atoms wale alag alag possible structures banayein.
blocks.explanation: Khuli chains (open chain): pentane, 2-methylbutane aur 2,2-dimethylpropane. Rings: cyclopentane, methylcyclobutane, ethylcyclopropane, 1,1-dimethylcyclopropane aur 1,2-dimethylcyclopropane.

blocks.prompt: b) Chhe carbon atoms wale alag alag open chain structures likhein.

items: Catenation: aik hi element ke atoms ka aapas mein jur kar chains aur rings banana.
Tetravalent carbon bohat se arrangements deta hai: sirf chaar C atoms se chaar structures.
Isi wajah se organic compounds itne zyada aur itne complex hain.
